hero.tagline: There are places where we live. And places where we truly begin to live.
hero.subtext: Casa Madre guides the purchase, sale, rental and investment of Barcelona properties — with a close, strategic and aesthetic eye.
hero.cta: Tell us what you're looking for

about.headlinePart1: Before you find your house, we want you to feel
about.body: Casa Madre begins with origin and intention — with the place where everything starts. And with a feeling we want to stay with you from the very first moment: that you are in good hands.

nosotras.headline: Two perspectives. One shared way of understanding home.
nosotras.body: We met in a house. One of us came from international advertising, the other from interior design. Casa Madre was born from that shared way of understanding how a space is lived.

detail.ctaHeadline: Tell us what you're looking for.
detail.ctaBody: We'll guide you at every step, with judgement and closeness.

items.title: Buying & Selling
items.description: We guide every transaction with strategy, valuation and sensibility.
items.cta: I want to buy or sell
items.tagline: Buying or selling isn't just a transaction. It's understanding the moment, the value, and what comes next.
items.intro: We guide buying and selling from a complete perspective. It's not only about finding or placing a property, but about doing it at the right moment, with the right judgement.
items.forWho: For those buying or selling a home who want to do it with strategy, judgement, and real support at every step.
includes: A genuine property valuation
A clear buying or marketing strategy
Careful management of the whole process
Support all the way to closing
process: We understand your moment and your goal
We define a personalised strategy
We value and position with judgement
We accompany every detail through to signing
items.difference: Because a good transaction doesn't come down to luck — it comes down to how it's done.

items.title: Rentals
items.description: Homes for every moment: seasonal and long-term.
items.tagline: Arriving at a home should feel easy. As if you already knew how to live in it.
items.intro: We select homes thought out for different moments in life, with everything ready for you to begin living.
items.forWho: For those arriving in Barcelona for a season or to stay, looking for a process that's smooth, secure and well cared for.
includes: Seasonal rental — for those arriving for a defined chapter, ready to begin
Long-term — for those seeking stability, rhythm and continuity
Property selection, documentation and contracts
Support throughout the whole process
process: We understand your moment and your stay
We select homes that fit you
We handle the documentation and contracts
We stay with you until you feel at home
items.difference: We don't just manage contracts. We care for the experience of living.

items.title: Personal Shopper
items.description: We search for you — understanding, filtering, finding.
items.tagline: When you don't know where to begin, we begin with you.
items.intro: We search for you. But first, we understand — what you need, what fits you, what makes sense right now.
items.forWho: For time-poor buyers, international clients, or anyone who'd rather entrust the search to someone they trust.
includes: Searching and filtering against your criteria
A selection of only the properties truly worth it
Access to off-market opportunities where possible
Visits organised with intention
process: First we understand what you're really looking for
We filter and select for you
We propose only what fits
We accompany the visit and the negotiation
items.difference: So you lose no time, and every visit has intention.

items.title: Renovation & Home Staging
items.description: We transform spaces so they tell their finest version.
items.tagline: A space can change completely once you understand how it's meant to be lived in.
items.intro: We work with spaces from the inside, so they tell their finest version without losing authenticity.
items.forWho: For owners, buyers and sellers who want to draw out the best of a space before selling, renting or living in it.
includes: Renovation — projects that turn a property into something coherent, functional and full of identity
Home staging — preparing a home to show at its very best
An analysis of the space's potential
Coordination with a network of specialist collaborators
process: We read the space and its potential
We propose improvements with aesthetic judgement
We coordinate the right professionals
We care for the result from start to finish
items.difference: It isn't about decorating. It's about interpreting the space.

items.title: Investment
items.description: We analyse, value and help you make sound decisions.
items.tagline: Every property is a decision. Some are also an opportunity.
items.intro: We analyse assets from a strategic perspective, to help you understand not just what to buy, but why.
items.forWho: For private investors and wealth-minded buyers seeking yield, appreciation and long-term value.
includes: Yield analysis
A study of potential and appreciation
Positioning the asset in the market
Support after the purchase, too
process: We study the asset and its context
We analyse yield and potential
We explain the reasoning behind each option
We accompany the decision and what follows
items.difference: Because investing well means reading beyond the present.

items.title: Legal & Financial
items.description: Legal and financial processes, with transparency and rigour.
items.tagline: Some processes need more than management. They need clarity.
items.intro: We work with a legal and financial team that guides complex situations with discretion and rigour.
items.forWho: For local and international clients facing sensitive matters who want clarity, security and discretion.
includes: Inheritances
Separations
Estate restructuring
Sensitive transactions and international buyers
process: We listen and understand the situation
We coordinate the right specialists
We manage with transparency and rigour
We see it through, without friction
items.difference: So everything is handled with transparency, security and no unnecessary friction.
